name: Ring of Far Sight
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 4th; Slot ring; Price 56,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

The ring grants the wearer improved vision, especially over long distances. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus to all sight-based Perception checks as well as a +2 attack bonus to hit with missile weapons beyond close range.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells arcane eye, Perception 5 ranks; Cost 28,000 gp

Identification DC 19
